recap.text: Wynne, a level 50 Dirigible Gnome Flesh Mechanic and uncle of Commandant Kane, is chained in a chamber below the town hall. Low Thi kills him with a spear, failing Carl's quest for a Silver Quest Box. Princess Donut uses Second Chance to raise Wynne's head for half an hour. Katia Grim hides in duct tape in a balloon basket to impersonate Wynne.

beats.headline: Chained beyond the boundary
beats.text: Subject: Wynne, Dirigible Gnome Flesh Mechanic, level 50. Located in a chamber below the town hall, past the shimmering quadrant boundary, chained to the wall. Elderly, no red hat, sickly, scabbed, half starved. Great and favoured uncle of Commandant Kane. A healer able to bring the long dead back to life, if only temporarily. Held by the dromedarians as a guarantee of peace. Crawler Carl was issued a quest to free him, reward a Silver Quest Box, and could not reach him from his side of the boundary.
beats.gist: Wynne is a level 50 Dirigible Gnome Flesh Mechanic and healer chained in a chamber.

beats.headline: Kill me fast
beats.text: Five crawlers arrived at a run on the subterranean side. Subject told them the human was no human but a changeling named Henrik, who was torturing him, drugging him, trying to make him give flesh to Quetzalcoatlus, and he would not last much longer. He said he had the map to the temple, and that if they killed him they would have access. Kill me fast, he said. Crawler Low Thi did, with a spear, over Crawler Carl's objection. Quest failed. There was no map.
beats.gist: Five crawlers find Wynne, who claims Henrik is a changeling torturing him for Quetzalcoatlus's flesh.

beats.headline: Years of the code
beats.text: Posthumous addendum, from Henrik, under Princess Donut's charm. Each day a watch alarm sounded and the gnomish Commandant made a sign in its mirror. Subject was shown the sign and named a time; the hands were set to it, and the gnomes knew he lived for another day. He cooperated for years. Only when he was moved to the chamber below the town hall did he understand the arrangement had changed, and stop. After that he was drugged with mushroom, and had to be fed more every day.
beats.gist: Henrik writes a posthumous addendum under Princess Donut's charm about Wynne.

beats.headline: Half an hour of Second Chance
beats.text: Subject's corpse was retrieved by the tomb raiders a few hours after death, chewed by beetles, face untouched. Princess Donut raised the head with Second Chance, reaching his level 50 from her 33 by way of her glass cannon class, for half an hour. Katia Grim supplied everything below it. Leon the Commissar laid a hand on the snapping head, found no changeling, and said it appeared to be a ghoul. Then the spell timed out behind his back, the head went to dust, and Katia grew a new one before anyone looked.
beats.gist: Princess Donut uses Second Chance to raise a beetle-chewed head for half an hour.

beats.headline: Looking better already
beats.text: The message Crawler Carl had Henrik send the Commandant, for the record: Wynne cast a resurrection spell for the dromedarians, became gravely ill, and a travelling healer would bring him out beyond the walls. By the time the balloon rose, the Wynne curled on the floor of the basket was Katia Grim in duct tape, keeping quiet because her voice work was barely passable, curled up to hide the extra height. Leon leaned down to look at her. He's looking better already, he said.
beats.gist: Carl has Henrik tell the Commandant that Wynne fell ill. Katia Grim in duct tape replaces him.
